sourceCopy.name: Cribbage Score Calculator and Game
sourceCopy.title: Cribbage Game & Score Calculator | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Play Cribbage against a local computer and score hands, pegging and the crib. Free, private, no account or network opponent.
sourceCopy.intro: Play a full local Cribbage match against a simple computer opponent, or score any hand or crib by entering four cards and the starter.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: Can I play a full Cribbage game here?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Start a local match, discard two of your six cards to the crib, then play legal cards toward 31. Score fifteens, pairs and runs; say go when you cannot play. Count the non-dealer hand, dealer hand and crib. The default target is 121 points and can be lowered for a shorter match.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Does this cribbage scorer upload my cards?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The match and scoring run in this browser. There is no online opponent, account, upload or saved match.

fields.rulesNote: Choose hand or crib, then enter four different cards and a different starter. The full local match is below; it uses a simple computer opponent and is not multiplayer.

additionalFaqs.question: How many points is a 15 in cribbage?
additionalFaqs.answer: Each distinct combination of cards that totals 15 scores two points. Several different combinations can score in the same hand.

additionalFaqs.question: How is a crib flush counted?
additionalFaqs.answer: All four crib cards and the starter must share a suit for five points. Unlike a regular hand, four matching crib cards without the starter do not score a flush.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I play against another person?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. The match is local against a simple browser opponent. There is no online multiplayer or saved match.
